summary: Gunter Nimtz and Alfons Stahlhofen, University of Koblenz, claim microwave photons travelled "instantaneously" across prisms separated up to three feet, exceeding light speed. Their experiment passed 30 cm microwaves through prism pairs, detecting refracted and tunneling photons arriving simultaneously. Critics cite the Hartman Effect and Herbert G Winful's research arguing evanescent waves do not propagate, casting doubt on their interpretation.
